Name: Persistent Grange Display
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
The basic function of this mod is to keep grange items in memory so you can reuse them every year, but...

If you install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON Assets[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7530]Bigger Craftables[/url], you can create your own copy of the grange display for your farm that will let you see how many points your grange is worth in advance.

To create your own grange display, you will need to install both the main mod and the optional content packs.

Note: because of how grange displays work, you can only have one set of grange display items and each built grange display will always reflect what is in the actual festival grange display.


[size=5][b]Technical Notes[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Source code is available at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].

Downloads.Description: This package makes grange items stay in the grange if you leave them there after the festival. Check the optional files for the packages that allow you to create your own copy of the grange display.
Contains two content packs, requires JSON Assets and Bigger Craftables.
